title: Don't Panic: My Strategy for this Market Sell-Off
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: CPI 3.7% vs 3.6% expected and core 2.6% raise odds of a Fed hold or hike at the meeting in ~2 weeks.
10-year back near 5.3% is pressuring valuations and mortgages and adding market uncertainty.
Debt concerns around CoreWeave and AI-infrastructure names are driving the sell-off.
